tools.name: bring_to_front
tools.description: Activate an exact app/window when the task needs visible foreground interaction. Prefer background input otherwise.

pid.description: Process ID of the app to activate.

window_id.description: CGWindowID to verify as the focused, frontmost window. Omit to activate the app only.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an exact tab's current DOM ref or CSS-pixel coordinates. Background by default. Returns a fresh semantic page observation with new refs; observe_query narrows it and observe_after:false omits it.

delivery_mode.description: background (default) refuses trusted input where it would activate the browser window (Linux Chromium). foreground accepts that activation, for a browser whose window nobody else is using (for example inside a sandbox).

ref.description: Page element ref in the p<snapshot>:<index> namespace from get_browser_state. Refs are invalidated by navigation and by newer snapshots of the same tab.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

x.description: Viewport x (CSS px) — alternative to ref.

y.description: Viewport y (CSS px) — alternative to ref.

tools.name: browser_dialog
tools.description: Inspect, accept or dismiss an exact tab's current JavaScript dialog using its dialog_id.

action.description: inspect returns the current dialog and its dialog_id; accept or dismiss resolves that exact dialog.

delivery_mode.description: Requested foreground posture for accept/dismiss. Linux Chromium requires foreground; inspect is read-only.

dialog_id.description: Opaque current dialog generation returned by action=inspect.

prompt_text.description: Sensitive response text, valid only when accepting a prompt dialog.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate an exactly bound browser tab to an HTTP, HTTPS or about URL without address-bar input. Returns a fresh semantic page observation by default.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

tools.name: browser_pointer
tools.description: Hover, right/double click, scroll or drag in an exact browser tab, using current DOM refs or CSS pixels. Returns a fresh semantic observation by default; observe_after:false omits it.

action.description: Pointer gesture. scroll needs delta_x or delta_y; drag needs destination_ref or to_x/to_y.

delivery_mode.description: background (default) refuses trusted input where it would activate the browser window (Linux Chromium). foreground accepts that activation, for a browser whose window nobody else is using (for example inside a sandbox).

delta_x.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels.

delta_y.description: Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels.

destination_ref.description: Drag destination page ref in the exact same frame.

input_route.description: trusted sends CDP Input events; dom_event synthesizes DOM events in the page and requires ref.

ref.description: Origin page ref. Alternative to x/y.

tab_id.description: Opaque tab id minted by get_browser_state.

target_id.description: Opaque target id minted by get_browser_state.

to_x.description: Drag destination viewport x in CSS pixels.

to_y.description: Drag destination viewport y in CSS pixels.

x.description: Origin viewport x in CSS pixels.

y.description: Origin viewport y in CSS pixels.

tools.name: browser_prepare
tools.description: Connect a supported Chromium browser for DOM tools. For signed-in tasks use pid/window_id with strategy.kind:existing_profile; enabled Cafe computer use pre-authorizes this attachment and native debugging setup. For separate automation use allow_launch:true with profile.mode:isolated_new. Never use a new logged-out profile for the user's account tasks.

allow_launch.description: Allow a separate driver-owned isolated Chromium process to be launched (default false).

pid.description: Browser process id to prepare. Required except for a driver-owned isolated_new/isolated_named launch with allow_launch=true.

profile.description: Driver-owned isolated Chromium profile to launch with allow_launch=true. mode=isolated_new creates a fresh throwaway profile; mode=isolated_named reuses the named driver-owned profile.

name.description: Required only for isolated_named; 1-64 path-safe ASCII characters.

strategy.description: Attach to an already-running browser instead of launching one. kind=existing_profile attaches to the user's running profile at pid/window_id and requires explicit profile authorization.

window_id.description: Exact native window approval anchor; required for strategy.kind=existing_profile.

tools.name: browser_set_input_files
tools.description: Assign explicit local files to an exact tab's current file-input ref. Use only files the user requested uploading.

files.description: Absolute paths of 1 to 32 local regular files to assign to the input.

items.description: Absolute path to one local regular file.

ref.description: Page element ref in the p<snapshot>:<index> namespace from get_browser_state. Refs are invalidated by navigation and by newer snapshots of the same tab.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Fill an exact tab's current DOM ref. replace:true replaces its value. Returns a fresh semantic observation with new refs; observe_query narrows it and observe_after:false omits it.

mode.description: insert_text (default): bulk Input.insertText. keystrokes: per-character Input.dispatchKeyEvent.

ref.description: Page element ref in the p<snapshot>:<index> namespace from get_browser_state. Refs are invalidated by navigation and by newer snapshots of the same tab.

replace.description: false (default): insert at the caret, appending to whatever the field already holds. true: select the element's whole content first so the text replaces it — with an empty text this clears the field.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

tools.name: click
tools.description: Prefer pid + element_token from a fresh window read for background AX clicking. Otherwise use pid/window_id with window-screenshot pixels and capture_id. Cafe automatically uses foreground after definite targeting refusals. Desktop pixels require scope:desktop.

action.description: AX action: press, show_menu, pick, confirm, cancel, open.

capture_id.description: Optional immutable source capture ID returned by get_window_state or get_desktop_state.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": perform the AX action or post the CGEvent without fronting. "foreground": briefly front the window, act, let transient UI settle, then restore the prior frontmost app.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

from_zoom.description: When true, x and y are in the last zoom image for this pid; driver translates back to full-window coordinates.

modifier.description: Modifier keys: cmd, shift, option/alt, ctrl.

scope.description: Coordinate frame for a windowless screen-absolute click (default "window").

target.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

window_id.description: Target window ID. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

y.description: Y in screenshot pixels from the image selected by target.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Inspect clipboard types; include_text:true reads its sensitive text only when needed for the user's task.

include_text.description:
Return plain-text clipboard content in addition to the available types.
Clipboard content is privacy-sensitive and is never retained in telemetry.

tools.name: clipboard_write
tools.description: Write exactly one clipboard value: text, an image path or a file path. Prefer targeted type_text/set_value for ordinary text entry.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local file to place on the clipboard as a file URL.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a local image to place on the clipboard.

text.description: Plain text to place on the clipboard.

tools.name: double_click
tools.description: Double-click a fresh element_token or window-local screenshot pixels in an exact pid/window_id. Background by default.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": inject without fronting or raising the target — no focus steal. "foreground": briefly front the target, act, then restore the prior frontmost — the explicit last resort when a background attempt didn't land.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

window_id.description: CGWindowID. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag between window-local screenshot pixels in an exact window. Use an explicit desktop scope for foreground desktop gestures.

button.description: Mouse button used for the drag. Default: left.

delivery_mode.description: Window-scoped drag on macOS supports only "foreground": briefly front the exact window (window_id required), drive the physical pointer through the gesture, then restore the prior frontmost app.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the drag path between mouseDown and mouseUp. Default: 500.

from_x.description: Drag-start X in window-local screenshot pixels. Top-left origin.

from_y.description: Drag-start Y in window-local screenshot pixels. Top-left origin.

from_zoom.description: When true, coordinates are in the last zoom image for this pid; driver maps back to window coordinates.

modifier.description: Modifier keys held across the entire gesture: cmd/shift/option/ctrl.

scope.description: Use desktop with no pid/window_id for native get_desktop_state screenshot coordinates.

steps.description: Number of intermediate mouseDragged events linearly interpolated along the path. Default: 20.

anyOf.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

to_x.description: Drag-end X in window-local screenshot pixels.

to_y.description: Drag-end Y in window-local screenshot pixels.

window_id.description: CGWindowID for the window the pixel coordinates were measured against.

tools.name: get_accessibility_tree
tools.description: Read a lightweight desktop inventory of apps and visible windows before selecting an exact window.

tools.name: get_agent_cursor_state
tools.description: Inspect this chat's native agent cursor visibility, position, theme and motion.

tools.name: get_browser_state
tools.description: Read exact browser tabs and actionable DOM refs. Defaults to semantic_v2 without screenshots. Native binding also snapshots the uniquely active tab. Use query, scope_ref and continuation to narrow/page output. If the browser needs a connection, use browser_prepare. Unsupported browsers retain native AX/pixel control.

continuation.description: Opaque continuation minted by an earlier semantic_v2 response.

include_screenshot.description: Capture the exact tab viewport as PNG through CDP without selecting the tab or foregrounding its native window. The request refuses if capture cannot be completed.

query.description: Read-only semantic match over role, accessible name, and visible text.

scope_ref.description: Current semantic/content ref whose subtree should be observed.

snapshot_format.description: Versioned snapshot contract. dom_refs_v1 remains the compatibility default.

target_id.description: Opaque browser target id minted by get_browser_state (session-scoped; never a CDP id).

window_id.description: Native window id owned by pid (bind mode).

tools.name: get_cursor_position
tools.description: Read the real mouse pointer position in screen points; this is distinct from the agent cursor overlay.

tools.name: get_desktop_state
tools.description: Capture the desktop for system UI or when window targeting is unavailable. Defaults to a 1280-pixel long edge; request 0 for native resolution.

max_image_dimension.description: Optional long-edge cap for the returned PNG, in pixels (aspect ratio preserved).

tools.name: get_screen_size
tools.description: Read logical display dimensions and backing scale for screen-point geometry.

tools.name: get_window_state
tools.description: Read a native window and its fresh element_token handles. Omit window_id to select a usable main window for pid. Tree-only by default: query searches up to 4000 nodes, otherwise 2000; max_results independently limits output to 200. Distinguish search_truncated from output_truncated. Request include_screenshot:true only for pixel grounding. Each read replaces the window's old tokens.

include_accessibility_tree.description: Default true — walk the AX tree and return `elements` + `tree_markdown` alongside the screenshot.

include_screenshot.description: Default true — returns a grounding screenshot alongside the tree.

max_depth.description: Cap on the AX-tree walk depth. Nodes whose rendered indent would exceed this are omitted. Omit for the default (25). Lower this for deep menu/Electron trees.

max_dimension.description: Optional cap on the returned screenshot's long edge, in pixels (aspect ratio preserved) — the cheap path for a small preview / thumbnail.

max_elements.description: Cap on the total number of AX nodes walked.

max_image_dimension.description: Per-call override for the returned screenshot's long edge in pixels.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter for tree_markdown and structured elements. Returns matching actionable rows plus their actionable ancestors without renumbering element_index values.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget in milliseconds for the accessibility-tree walk (default 1000, min 100, max 120000).

tools.name: hotkey
tools.description: Send a key combination to an exact window, preferring background delivery. Explicit scope:desktop sends it to the foreground app.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": inject without fronting or raising the target — no focus steal. "foreground": briefly front the target, act, then restore the prior frontmost — the explicit last resort when a background attempt didn't land.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

keys.description: Modifier(s) and one non-modifier key, e.g. ["cmd", "c"].

scope.description: Use desktop with no pid/window_id to send the chord to the frontmost application.

anyOf.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

window_id.description: Target window. Required for delivery_mode:"foreground" (the NSMenu activation needs a window). Does NOT itself raise the window — raising is gated on delivery_mode.

x.description: Screenshot-pixel X — the element px action form: pixel-click there to focus, then send the combo (so e.g.

tools.name: invoke_menu
tools.description: Invoke an exact app menu path through accessibility, avoiding repeated menu screenshots and pixel clicks.

inputSchema.description:
Exact, immediate-child application menu path to resolve and invoke through
the operating system's accessibility API.

path.description:
Menu labels from the top-level menu to the item, e.g. `["File", "Save As..."]`
(1 to 16 labels).

pid.description: Process ID of the application that owns the menu.

window_id.description: Window ID from list_windows whose menu is invoked.

tools.name: kill_app
tools.description: Force-terminate an exact app pid. Destructive: use only when the user requests termination and account for unsaved work.

pid.description: PID of the process to terminate.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch an installed app in the background by bundle_id (preferred) or name. Returns pid, a ranked main-window recommendation and up to eight usable windows. URL handoff is not verified navigation; prefer open_url for websites in the user's browser.

additional_arguments.description: Extra arguments appended after --args when launching.

bundle_id.description: App bundle identifier, e.g. com.apple.calculator. Preferred over name.

creates_new_application_instance.description: When true, force a new app instance even if already running (open -n).

name.description: App display name. Used only when bundle_id is absent.

urls.description: Optional file paths or URLs to open with the app (e.g. a folder path for Finder).

webkit_inspector_port.description: Open a WebKit inspector server on this port (sets WEBKIT_INSPECTOR_SERVER env var).

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List running and installed apps with bundle IDs, pids and state flags for native app launching.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List ranked native windows and recommended_window. Tiny previews and completion windows are excluded by default; up to eight windows are returned. Filter by pid or query. Increase max_windows or include_auxiliary_windows to inspect omitted windows.

on_screen_only.description: When true, drop windows not on the current Space. Default false.

pid.description: Optional pid filter. When set, only this pid's windows are returned.

tools.name: move_cursor
tools.description: Move this chat's labelled agent cursor in screen points. Default window scope leaves the real pointer alone; explicit desktop scope moves the real pointer in desktop-screenshot pixels.

scope.description: "window" (default) moves only the agent cursor overlay; "desktop" moves the real OS pointer.

anyOf.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

x.description: Destination X. Window scope: screen points for the agent cursor overlay. Desktop scope: native get_desktop_state screenshot pixels.

y.description: Destination Y, in the same space as x.

tools.name: page
tools.description: Browser compatibility actions for text, DOM queries and JavaScript on supported Safari/WebKit/CDP targets. Prefer exact-tab browser_* tools. Enabling browser JavaScript automation requires the user's separate confirmation.

attributes.description: Element attributes to include in query_dom results.

bundle_id.description: Bundle ID of the browser. Required for enable_javascript_apple_events (macOS only).

cdp_port.description: Optional, for execute_javascript/insert_text/type_keystrokes: use this exact CDP port instead of auto-discovering one from pid.

javascript.description: JavaScript to execute. Required for execute_javascript.

target_url_contains.description: Optional, for execute_javascript/insert_text/type_keystrokes: require exactly one browser tab whose URL contains this substring.

text.description: Text to insert or type. Required for insert_text and type_keystrokes. The target field must already have DOM focus (click/focus it first).

user_has_confirmed_enabling.description: Must be true to proceed with enable_javascript_apple_events. This will quit and relaunch the browser.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press one key in an exact window, preferring background delivery. Explicit scope:desktop acts in the foreground app.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": inject without fronting or raising the target — no focus steal. "foreground": briefly front the target, act, then restore the prior frontmost — the explicit last resort when a background attempt didn't land.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

key.description: Key name: return, tab, escape, up, down, etc.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys: cmd, shift, option/alt, ctrl, fn.

scope.description: Use desktop with no pid/window_id to send the key to the frontmost application.

anyOf.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

window_id.description: Target window. Required for delivery_mode:"foreground". Does NOT itself raise the window — raising is gated on delivery_mode.

x.description: Screenshot-pixel X — the element px action form: pixel-click there to focus, then send the key.

tools.name: right_click
tools.description: Open an exact element's context menu through AX or window-local pixels. Use fresh element tokens; background by default.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": inject without fronting or raising the target — no focus steal. "foreground": briefly front the target, act, then restore the prior frontmost — the explicit last resort when a background attempt didn't land.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

modifier.description: Modifier keys held during the right-click: cmd/shift/option/ctrl. Pixel path only.

window_id.description: CGWindowID. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

x.description: X in window-local screenshot pixels. Must be provided together with y.

y.description: Y in window-local screenshot pixels. Must be provided together with x.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll an exact window in the background using its current element token or screenshot coordinates.

amount.description: Pixel-wheel path: number of wheel notches. Keystroke path: number of keystroke repetitions. Larger requests are clamped to the maximum. Default: 3.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": inject without fronting or raising the target — no focus steal. "foreground": briefly front the target, act, then restore the prior frontmost — the explicit last resort when a background attempt didn't land.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

pid.description: Target process ID. Required unless scope is "desktop".

scope.description: Use desktop with x,y and no pid/window_id for native get_desktop_state screenshot coordinates.

anyOf.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

window_id.description: CGWindowID of the target window. Required with x/y; optional with element_token (the token carries it).

x.description: Window-local screenshot X (top-left origin of the PNG from get_window_state).

tools.name: set_agent_cursor_enabled
tools.description: Show or hide only this chat's native agent cursor; this does not grant or revoke computer control.

enabled.description: `true` shows the session's agent cursor overlay; `false` hides it.

tools.name: set_agent_cursor_motion
tools.description: Tune this chat's agent cursor motion, effects and idle visibility. The native cursor respects reduced motion.

arc_flow.description:
Added to the arc asymmetry of `signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`:
positive moves the apex toward the destination. Clamped to -1..1 (default 0).

arc_size.description:
Scales the arc of `signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`: 0.25 (default)
keeps the style's arc, 0 is a straight line, 0.5 doubles it. Clamped to 0..1.

dwell_after_click_ms.description: Pause after a click animation, in milliseconds. Clamped to 0..5000 (default 80).

effects.description:
Turn single effects on or off. An omitted effect keeps its current setting; null
restores the style's default.

glow.description: Soft glow around the cursor that grows with speed.

magnet.description: Target glow when the `magnetic` style locks on.

ripple.description: Ring that expands from the hotspot on click.

squish.description: Brief scale-down of the cursor on click.

trail.description: Short fading trail behind the cursor.

end_handle.description:
Arc control-point offset from the end, as a fraction of the distance, for
`signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`. Clamped to 0..1 (default 0.3).

glide_duration_ms.description:
Move duration in milliseconds for `fixed` timing (1430 ms when 0, the default). A
nonzero value with `native` timing also fixes the duration. Clamped to 0..5000.

idle_hide_ms.description:
Hide the cursor after this many idle milliseconds; 0 never hides it. Clamped to
0..60000 (default 15000).

spring.description:
Arrival spring damping for `classic`: 1 is critically damped, 0.3 is bouncy. Clamped
to 0.3..1 (default 0.72).

start_handle.description:
Arc control-point offset from the start, as a fraction of the distance, for
`signature_arc`, `spring_settle` and `comet_swoop`. Clamped to 0..1 (default 0.3).

timing.description:
`native` uses the style's own timing; `fitts` scales the move time with distance and
target size; `fixed` uses glide_duration_ms (1430 ms when 0).

turn_radius.description:
Minimum turning radius of the `classic` glide path, in points; smaller turns tighter.
Clamped to 1..1000 (default 80).

tools.name: set_agent_cursor_theme
tools.description: Choose an already installed native cursor theme and reduced-motion setting. Does not install themes.

reduced_motion.description:
Theme animation policy: `on` uses the theme's reduced-motion frames, `off` always
animates, `auto` (default) leaves the choice to the host.

theme_id.description: Id of an installed cursor theme (see `cua-driver cursor-theme list`).

tools.name: set_value
tools.description: Set an exact fresh AX element's value directly, avoiding focus changes and repeated keystrokes. Verify with a fresh read.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

value.description: New value. AX will coerce to the element's native type.

window_id.description: CGWindowID. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

tools.name: set_window_frame
tools.description: Resize or reposition one exact native window, with independent geometry verification.

height.description: New height, in the same units as list_windows bounds.

pid.description: Process ID that owns the window.

width.description: New width, in the same units as list_windows bounds.

x.description: New left edge in the desktop coordinate space reported by list_windows.

y.description: New top edge in the desktop coordinate space reported by list_windows.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Insert text into a fresh AX element or an exact window's field. Prefer background delivery and element_token; window screenshot x/y can establish renderer focus. Cafe automatically uses foreground after definite targeting refusals. Scope:desktop types into the foreground app.

delay_ms.description: Milliseconds between characters in the CGEvent fallback path. Default 30. Ignored when the AX path succeeds.

delivery_mode.description: Best-effort-background ladder rung (default "background"). "background": AX insert, then CGEvent keystrokes if needed — no focus steal; native controls can be confirmed via AXValue read-back, while web-content writes remain effect:"unverifiable". "foreground": briefly front the window, type, restore the prior frontmost — the explicit last resort for focus-sensitive surfaces (e.g.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. Returns an explicit stale error naming the current snapshots once a newer read supersedes it.

scope.description: Use desktop with no pid/window_id to type into the frontmost application.

anyOf.description:
Exact capture/input target selected independently for each action.

`display_id="primary"` is the portable desktop target in this release.

target.description:
Preferred per-call target: an exact window (`kind="window"`, `pid`, `window_id`) or the
primary desktop (`kind="desktop"`, `display_id="primary"`).

text.description: Text to insert at the target's cursor.

window_id.description: CGWindowID. Omit when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

x.description: Screenshot-pixel X of the field to type into — the element px action form.

y.description: Screenshot-pixel Y of the field (see x).

tools.name: verify_state
tools.description: Wait for up to eight bounded exact-window/element predicates without repeated screenshot polling. Images are optional; default off.

expect.description: One to eight predicates, combined with logical AND.

exists.description: Assert that at least one trusted element matches the selector.

include_screenshot.description:
Return the final window screenshot as image content for a multimodal
caller. The driver does not interpret that image.

pid.description: Exact process whose window may be observed.

stable_samples.description: Consecutive satisfied samples required before returning success.

timeout_ms.description: Bounded wait. Zero performs one sample.

tools.name: zoom
tools.description: Capture a cropped window region for small pixel targets. Coordinates use the last window screenshot; from_zoom:true maps later input back to that window.

pid.description: Optional target pid. When omitted, the driver resolves the unique current snapshot for this session and window.

x1.description: Left edge of region in screenshot pixels.

x2.description: Right edge of region in screenshot pixels.

y1.description: Top edge of region in screenshot pixels.

y2.description: Bottom edge of region in screenshot pixels.
